# Dragoon's Town v0.20

The town now has a complete illustrated interface, a fuller waterfront scene and visible everyday activity. Existing finances, holdings and saved progress are preserved.

- Original portrait and landscape town artwork fills the screen, with a parchment cash panel, illustrated purchase dock and five clear bottom navigation tabs.
- Matching illustrated icons cover businesses, estates, homes, vehicles, markets, teams and menus.
- Citizens walk along town routes, while boats occasionally sail through the harbor. Activity grows with town development and pauses when the town is hidden.
- Optional activity controls, reduced motion and battery-saving settings keep animation manageable on phones.
- Precise storefront hitboxes and visible price tags make purchases reliable, including neighboring buildings and the landscape shopping layout.
- Portrait and landscape layouts keep the bank, selected business, purchase quantity and income preview accessible.

The existing economy, prestige, offline earnings, upgrades and save protection remain in place. No real payments, ads or real financial trading were added.

Android: compatible update for the existing app, version code 9, minimum SDK 24 (Android 7). Android 13 remains supported. Install through More → App updates → Check now without uninstalling; your save stays on the device.

Shared gameplay/save regressions, all six Chrome viewport checks, Android preview assembly and native unit tests passed before publication. The compatible release workflow verifies the original signing certificate, package, version and uploaded/downloaded APK bytes. Physical Thor/Android 13 playtesting remains outstanding.

AI-assisted development with OpenAI Codex.
